name: studydaily-apkg
description: Turn notes, documents, and conversations into downloadable APKG flashcards for Study Daily and Anki.

interface.longDescription: Turn your notes, documents, and conversations into question-and-answer flashcards. Download an Anki-compatible APKG deck and import it into Study Daily or Anki to review with spaced repetition. The file is generated in the conversation's Python environment, with no Study Daily server or account required. Includes a Study Daily import guide. Supports basic text cards only; no media, cloze cards, review history, sync, or automatic import. Requires a conversation with Python execution and downloadable file support. Large sources can be split into multiple decks to fit file-size and execution limits. Study Daily is independent of Anki and OpenAI.
defaultPrompt: Create 12 flashcards from these notes as an APKG deck for Study Daily or Anki.
Turn this conversation into downloadable question-and-answer flashcards.
